title: Live-output & Action Invocation Interop Certification
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Provide a deterministic certification harness and test plan that validates streaming outputs and external action/tool invocations for newly onboarded models and pinned versions. This ticket covers building the test runner, defining golden prompt sets, automating end-to-end canary probes, and publishing a compatibility artifact (pass/fail matrix + performance profile) to the model catalog.

Background: Recent onboards have surfaced subtle interop failures when models emit interleaved text and tool-call frames (e.g., early function metadata, chunk boundaries, or partial JSON). Failures show up as: dropped function calls during backpressure, mismatched chunk affinity across multiplexed streams, and latency regressions when KV cache prefetch patterns differ from expected. We need a reproducible certification flow so PMs/Onboarders can publish a "streaming+action" compatibility badge and attach a performance profile (P90 latency, tail jitter, token throughput) to the model entry.

Scope:
- Positive and negative test cases for function/tool invocation semantics under continuous streaming (single-client & multiplexed).
- Canary probes for pinned-model endpoints that run as part of onboarding and pre-rollout checks.
- Automation that produces a human-readable artifact: compatibility verdict, per-check logs, perf histogram snapshots, and recommended profile (batching/quantization hints).

Out-of-scope:
- Changes to model kernels or model itself. This ticket focuses on verification and telemetry only.
tasks: Define golden prompt corpus (50 prompts covering short, long, and mid-sequence function invocations)
Implement harness to emulate multiplexed clients with configurable backpressure and chunk sizes
Integrate harness with runtime tracing to capture chunk-level sequence IDs, KV cache hits/misses, and per-frame latencies
Create CI job that runs harness against new onboarded model snapshot and pinned-version endpoints
Produce compatibility artifact generator (markdown + JSON summary) and attach to model catalog entry
Add canary dashboard panels: live-pass-rate, P95/P99 tail latency, function-call success-rate, drop/retry counts
acceptance_criteria: Harness can exercise streaming + function-call flows deterministically (seeded RNG) across 3 hardware profiles (A100, H100, T4)
End-to-end CI job produces artifact with pass/fail per-test and a perf profile that can be consumed by Console
Canary probes detect regressions introduced by model or runtime changes with >90% precision in staging
Artifact format documented and consumed by model-onboarding checklist; product can pin release only if badge present or flagged with risk
No flaky tests: >95% pass stability across 20 consecutive runs in staging for known-good model snapshot
technical_notes: Use the existing streaming test harness as base but replace framing validator with a deterministic chunk reassembly module
Record a timing fingerprint per logical function invocation: (start-frame-ts, end-frame-ts, token-count, retries)
Simulate backpressure via configurable ACK delays; verify that function calls are not lost when ACK is delayed up to 3s
Leverage runtime tracing hooks to include kv-prefetch and cache-eviction markers alongside application-level events
Runner will expose a small js/py SDK to drive multiplexed clients for reliability teams and Onboarding engineers
Performance profile fields: p50_latency_ms, p90_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, throughput_tokens_per_s, function_call_success_rate
